title: Essential: River flow velocity
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer must be the correct flow velocity of the river, 0.75 m/s.

title: Important: Block motion equation
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly express the distance the block travels downstream from the bridge using the flow velocity and total time.

title: Important: Boat's two-stage motion
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly model the boat's upstream and downstream segments, accounting for relative velocities to the ground.

title: Important: Time relation
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly incorporate the given 1-hour (3600 s) downstream rowing time into the equations.

title: Optional: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The solution demonstrates consistent use of units (e.g., meters and seconds) throughout the calculation.

title: Pitfall: Sign error in relative velocity
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student uses incorrect signs for the boat's speed relative to the ground when going upstream or downstream.

title: Pitfall: Ignoring block's travel time
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student fails to account for the time the block was drifting before the turn-around.
